test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Match the following characteristics in the modern periodic table:

 
 

 i.
 Total number of blocks in table
 a.
 4
 
 

 ii.
 Total number of periods
 b.
 2
 
 

 iii.
 Number of elements in K shell
 c.
 8
 
 

 iv.
 Number of elements in M shell
 d.
 7
 
 

 v
 Number of elements in L shell
 e.
 18

options.text: i - b, ii - a, iii - d, iv - c, v - e
i - a, ii - b, iii - c, iv - d, v - e
i - e, ii - c, iii - a, iv - b, v - d
i - a, ii - d, iii - b, iv - e, v - c

solution:
The correct answer is__** i - a, ii - d, iii - b, iv - e, v - c.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **modern periodic table** consists of **18 groups and 7 periods.**
 
• The K shell can hold a maximum of **2 electrons,** the L shell can hold a maximum of **8 electrons,** and the M shell can hold a maximum of 18 electrons.</stro
